They are supposed to have high output and good bass and mids. All I can say is Holy Shit. First, the price. They cost $83 including shipping to the US. Second, the sound. At first I was not happy with my purchase but it was my own fault. I had strung some Slinky 9-42 I had laying around on it and everything was just crappy.
